description.html: This dish has a grey-olive color and a slightly irregular, squarish shape. One side features a bold spiral, wavy relief that resembles a fossil imprint or a stone shaped by water over centuries. The inside is smooth and roomy.

Besides being a water dish, it works well as a feeder. You can serve chopped vegetables and greens for a bearded dragon or tortoise, or insects for lizards. The food stays in one place and does not mix with the substrate, so your animal does not swallow sand or soil along with its meal.
The relief side gives a good foothold, so it is handy to turn it toward the side your animal approaches from.

If you use the dish for food, remove leftover vegetables the same evening, since they spoil quickly in a warm terrarium. For water, change it every day. Clean the spiral relief with a small brush and rinse the dish well before refilling. See our lizard food page for food options.
